mentions.name: Android Server Unlock
mentions.description: A 2-factor verification system for unlocking servers. It uses clevis and a custom tang server so servers can be unlocked with a tap on your phone instead of a password or traditional tang network unlock. Even if someone steals the hardware, it cannot be unlocked without the owner approving the unlock.
mentions.problem: The author was unsatisfied with available remote unlock systems for homelab hardware.
mentions.audience: Homelab owners and self-hosters who want secure remote server unlocking
mentions.source_excerpt:
A 2factor verification system for server unlocking. I was unsatisfied with available remote unlock systems for homelab hardware and so built this: https://codeberg.org/dsjkrewpid/android-server-unlock

Its very rough, but it uses clevis and a custom tang server to unlock servers with a tap on your phone instead of a password or traditional tang network unlock.
